Mangal Dosha::kinship.sanskrit_shloka:
लग्ने व्यये च पाताले जामित्रे चाष्टमे कुजे ।
शुभदृग्योगहीने च पत्युर्हन्ति न संशयः ॥
Mangal Dosha::kinship.transliteration:
lagne vyaye ca pātāle jāmitre cāṣṭame kuje |
śubha-dṛg-yoga-hīne ca patyur hanti na saṃśayaḥ ||
Mangal Dosha::kinship.word_gloss: lagne = in 1st | vyaye = in 12th | pātāle = in 4th (nadir) | jāmitre = in 7th | aṣṭame = in 8th | kuje = Mars | śubha-dṛg-yoga-hīne = lacking benefic aspect/conjunction | patyuḥ = of spouse | hanti = destroys | na saṃśayaḥ = no doubt

Venus_afflicted_combust_or_dusthana::kin.sanskrit_shloka:
षष्ठाष्टमव्ययगते भृगुजे कलत्रं
दुःखप्रदं भवति नीचगते तथैव ।
अस्तंगते रविकरैरभिभूतदेहे
दाम्पत्यसौख्यरहितः खलु जातको हि ॥
Venus_afflicted_combust_or_dusthana::kin.transliteration:
ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-vyaya-gate bhṛgu-je kalatraṃ
duḥkha-pradaṃ bhavati nīca-gate tathaiva |
astaṅ-gate ravi-karair abhibhūta-dehe
dāmpatya-saukhya-rahitaḥ khalu jātako hi ||
Venus_afflicted_combust_or_dusthana::kin.word_gloss: ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-vyaya-gate = situated in 6/8/12 | bhṛgu-je = Venus | kalatraṃ = wife | duḥkha-pradaṃ = sorrow-giving | nīca-gate = in debilitation | astaṅ-gate = combust | ravi-karaiḥ = by sun-rays | abhibhūta-dehe = overpowered body | dāmpatya-saukhya = marital happiness | rahitaḥ = deprived

Mars_Venus_combination::kinship.sanskrit_shloka:
कुजशुक्रसमायोगे जातः परदारगः ।
गुप्तकामरतो नित्यं स्त्रीदोषेण विनश्यति ॥
Mars_Venus_combination::kinship.transliteration:

gupta-kāma-rato nityaṃ strī-doṣeṇa vinaśyati ||
Mars_Venus_combination::kinship.word_gloss: kuja = Mars | śukra = Venus | samāyoge = in conjunction | jātaḥ = native | para-dāra-gaḥ = goes to others' wives | gupta-kāma-rataḥ = devoted to clandestine desire | nityaṃ = constantly | strī-doṣeṇa = through fault of women | vinaśyati = is ruined

Chandra-Mangal::kinship.sanskrit_shloka:
चन्द्रमङ्गलसंयोगे धनयोगो भवेन्नृणाम् ।
मातुर्विरोधकारी च पण्यजीवी कलाप्रियः ॥
Chandra-Mangal::kinship.transliteration:
candra-maṅgala-saṃyoge dhana-yogo bhaven nṛṇām |
mātur-virodha-kārī ca paṇya-jīvī kalā-priyaḥ ||
Chandra-Mangal::kinship.word_gloss: candra = Moon | maṅgala = Mars | saṃyoge = conjunction | dhana-yogaḥ = wealth-combination | bhavet = arises | nṛṇām = for humans | mātuḥ = of mother | virodha-kārī = causing conflict | paṇya-jīvī = living by trade | kalā-priyaḥ = fond of arts

Sunapha_Anapha_Durudhura::kinship.sanskrit_shloka:
चन्द्रादन्ये द्वितीयस्थाः सुनफा परिकीर्तिताः ।
व्ययस्था अनफाख्याता उभयस्था दुरुधुरा ॥
Sunapha_Anapha_Durudhura::kinship.transliteration:
candrād anye dvitīya-sthāḥ sunaphā parikīrtitāḥ |
vyaya-sthā anaphākhyātā ubhaya-sthā durudhurā ||
Sunapha_Anapha_Durudhura::kinship.word_gloss: candrāt = from Moon | anye = other planets (excl. Sun) | dvitīya-sthāḥ = in 2nd | sunaphā = called Sunapha | vyaya-sthā = in 12th | anaphā-ākhyātā = called Anapha | ubhaya-sthā = in both | durudhurā = called Durudhura

bhava_4_planet_Saturn::kinship.sanskrit_shloka:
सुखस्थाने स्थितः सौरिर्मातृसौख्यं विनाशयेत् ।
गृहक्लेशं वाहनहानिं भूमिनाशं करोति च ॥
bhava_4_planet_Saturn::kinship.transliteration:
sukha-sthāne sthitaḥ sauriḥ mātṛ-saukhyaṃ vināśayet |
gṛha-kleśaṃ vāhana-hāniṃ bhūmi-nāśaṃ karoti ca ||
bhava_4_planet_Saturn::kinship.word_gloss: sukha-sthāne = in 4H (house of happiness) | sthitaḥ = situated | sauriḥ = Saturn | mātṛ-saukhyaṃ = mother-happiness | vināśayet = destroys | gṛha-kleśaṃ = household distress | vāhana-hāniṃ = loss of vehicles | bhūmi-nāśaṃ = loss of land

Gajakesari::career_wealth.sanskrit_shloka:
केन्द्रे चन्द्राद्गुरुर्यस्य तिष्ठेद् राशिवशं गतः ।
गजकेसरिसंज्ञोऽयं योगो भवति मानवे ॥
तेजस्वी धनवान् भोगी कीर्तिमान् वाग्मिनां वरः ।
राजमान्यः सुखी विद्वान् दीर्घायुर्जायते नरः ॥
Gajakesari::career_wealth.transliteration:
kendre candrād gurur yasya tiṣṭhed rāśi-vaśaṃ gataḥ |
gaja-kesari-saṃjño 'yaṃ yogo bhavati mānave ||
tejasvī dhanavān bhogī kīrtimān vāgmināṃ varaḥ |
rāja-mānyaḥ sukhī vidvān dīrghāyur jāyate naraḥ ||
Gajakesari::career_wealth.word_gloss: kendre = in kendra (1/4/7/10) | candrāt = from Moon | guruḥ = Jupiter | tiṣṭhet = stands | gaja-kesari = elephant-lion | tejasvī = lustrous | dhanavān = wealthy | bhogī = enjoyer | kīrtimān = famous | vāgmināṃ varaḥ = best of orators | rāja-mānyaḥ = honored by kings | dīrgha-āyuḥ = long-lived

strong_10L::career_wealth.sanskrit_shloka:
कर्मेशे केन्द्रकोणस्थे स्वोच्चस्वक्षेत्रसंयुते ।
राज्यदोऽयं समाख्यातः कीर्तिं सेनापतित्वकम् ॥
strong_10L::career_wealth.transliteration:
karmeśe kendra-koṇa-sthe svocca-sva-kṣetra-saṃyute |

strong_10L::career_wealth.word_gloss: karmeśe = 10th-lord | kendra-koṇa-sthe = in kendra or trikona | sva-ucca = own exaltation | sva-kṣetra = own sign | saṃyute = joined | rājya-daḥ = giver of kingdom | kīrtiṃ = fame | senā-patitvakam = generalship/command

bhava_10_planet_Saturn::career_wealth.sanskrit_shloka:
कर्मस्थाने स्थितः सौरिः स्वोच्चस्वगृहसंयुतः ।
महाकर्मरतो जातो राजतुल्यो महायशाः ॥
bhava_10_planet_Saturn::career_wealth.transliteration:
karma-sthāne sthitaḥ sauriḥ svocca-sva-gṛha-saṃyutaḥ |
mahā-karma-rato jāto rāja-tulyo mahā-yaśāḥ ||
bhava_10_planet_Saturn::career_wealth.word_gloss: karma-sthāne = in 10H | sthitaḥ = situated | sauriḥ = Saturn | sva-ucca = own exaltation (Libra) | sva-gṛha = own sign (Capricorn/Aquarius) | saṃyutaḥ = endowed | mahā-karma-rataḥ = engaged in great works | rāja-tulyaḥ = equal to a king | mahā-yaśāḥ = of great fame

Lakshmi::career_wealth.sanskrit_shloka:
भाग्येशो स्वोच्चसंस्थो वा स्वक्षेत्रे केन्द्रगो यदि ।
लग्नेशेन समायुक्तो लक्ष्मीयोग उदाहृतः ॥
धनधान्यसुतैर्युक्तो भोगवान् कीर्तिमान्भवेत् ।
राजमान्यः सदा हृष्टो लक्ष्मीवान् जायते नरः ॥
Lakshmi::career_wealth.transliteration:
bhāgyeśo svocca-saṃstho vā sva-kṣetre kendra-go yadi |
lagneśena samāyukto lakṣmī-yoga udāhṛtaḥ ||
dhana-dhānya-sutair yukto bhogavān kīrtimān bhavet |
rāja-mānyaḥ sadā hṛṣṭo lakṣmīvān jāyate naraḥ ||
Lakshmi::career_wealth.word_gloss: bhāgyeśaḥ = 9th-lord | svocca-saṃsthaḥ = in exaltation | sva-kṣetre = in own sign | kendra-gaḥ = in kendra | lagneśena = with Lagna-lord | lakṣmī-yogaḥ = Lakshmi Yoga | dhana-dhānya-sutaiḥ = with wealth, grain, sons | lakṣmīvān = endowed with Lakshmi

Vipareeta Raja::career_wealth.sanskrit_shloka:
षष्ठाष्टव्ययनाथानां परिवर्तेन योगकृत् ।
विपरीतो महाराज्यो योगो भवति मानवे ॥
Vipareeta Raja::career_wealth.transliteration:

viparīto mahā-rājyo yogo bhavati mānave ||
Vipareeta Raja::career_wealth.word_gloss: ṣaṣṭha = 6th | aṣṭa = 8th | vyaya = 12th | nāthānāṃ = of the lords | parivartena = by mutual exchange | viparīto = reversed | mahā-rājyaḥ = great kingdom

Saraswati::career_wealth.sanskrit_shloka:
ज्ञो भृगुर्जीवयुक्तो वा केन्द्रकोणधनस्थिताः ।
स्वोच्चस्वमित्रराशिस्थे जीवे सरस्वती स्मृता ॥
विद्वान् कविः कृतज्ञश्च सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः ।
धनधान्यसमायुक्तो लोकविख्यातकीर्तिमान् ॥
Saraswati::career_wealth.transliteration:
jño bhṛgur jīva-yukto vā kendra-koṇa-dhana-sthitāḥ |
svocca-sva-mitra-rāśi-sthe jīve sarasvatī smṛtā ||
Saraswati::career_wealth.word_gloss: jñaḥ = Mercury | bhṛguḥ = Venus | jīva-yuktaḥ = joined with Jupiter | kendra-koṇa-dhana-sthitāḥ = in kendra/trikona/2H | vidvān = learned | kaviḥ = poet | sarva-śāstra-viśāradaḥ = expert in all sastras

strong_11L::career_wealth.sanskrit_shloka:
लाभेशो स्वोच्चसंस्थो वा स्वर्क्षे केन्द्रत्रिकोणगः ।
नानादेशधनप्राप्तिं सर्वकामार्थसिद्धिदः ॥
strong_11L::career_wealth.transliteration:
lābheśo svocca-saṃstho vā svarkṣe kendra-trikoṇa-gaḥ |

strong_11L::career_wealth.word_gloss: lābheśaḥ = 11th-lord | svocca-saṃsthaḥ = in exaltation | svarkṣe = in own sign | kendra-trikoṇa-gaḥ = in kendra or trikona | nānā-deśa = from many countries | dhana-prāptiṃ = gain of wealth | sarva-kāma-artha = all desires and material aims

Jupiter_9H_param_bhagya::dharma.sanskrit_shloka:
देवगुरौ नवमे स्थिते पिता भवेत् शास्त्रज्ञो धर्मपरो नृपः।
पुत्रवान् धनवान् धीमान् भाग्यवान् सत्यवादिनः॥
Jupiter_9H_param_bhagya::dharma.transliteration:

putravān dhanavān dhīmān bhāgyavān satya-vādinaḥ ||
Jupiter_9H_param_bhagya::dharma.word_gloss: devaguru = Jupiter | navame = in 9H | sthite = situated | pitā = father | śāstrajñaḥ = scripture-knower | dharma-paraḥ = devoted to dharma | nṛpaḥ = king-like | putravān = with sons | dhanavān = wealthy | bhāgyavān = fortunate | satya-vādinaḥ = truthful

bhava_12_planet_Ketu::dharma.sanskrit_shloka:
व्ययस्थे केतुना जातो मोक्षलाभं समश्नुते।
विदेशवासी विरक्तश्च व्ययी पापविवर्जितः॥
bhava_12_planet_Ketu::dharma.transliteration:
vyaya-sthe ketunā jāto mokṣa-lābhaṃ samaśnute |
videśa-vāsī viraktaś ca vyayī pāpa-vivarjitaḥ ||

Saraswati::dharma.sanskrit_shloka:
ज्ञे शुक्रे च गुरौ केन्द्रत्रिकोणधनगैः शुभैः।
सरस्वती इति योगोऽयं कविर्वाग्मी प्रसिद्धवान्॥
Saraswati::dharma.transliteration:
jñe śukre ca gurau kendra-trikoṇa-dhana-gaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
sarasvatī iti yogo'yaṃ kavir vāgmī prasiddha-vān ||
Saraswati::dharma.word_gloss: jñe = Mercury | śukre = Venus | gurau = Jupiter | kendra-trikoṇa-dhana-gaiḥ = in kendra/trikona/2H | śubhaiḥ = beneficially | kaviḥ = poet | vāgmī = eloquent | prasiddha-vān = famous

Pitra_Dosha::dharma.sanskrit_shloka:
सूर्ये पापग्रहाक्रान्ते राहुणा वा शनैश्चरैः।
पितृऋणं भवेज्जातः पितृदोषो विनिर्दिशेत्॥
Pitra_Dosha::dharma.transliteration:
sūrye pāpa-grahākrānte rāhuṇā vā śanaiścaraiḥ |
pitṛ-ṛṇaṃ bhavej jātaḥ pitṛ-doṣo vinirdiśet ||
Pitra_Dosha::dharma.word_gloss: sūrye = Sun | pāpa-grahākrānte = afflicted by malefics | rāhuṇā = by Rahu | śanaiścaraiḥ = by Saturn | pitṛ-ṛṇam = ancestral debt | pitṛ-doṣaḥ = paternal karmic blemish | vinirdiśet = should be declared

Jupiter_5H_mantra_vidya::dharma.sanskrit_shloka:
पञ्चमस्थे सुरगुरौ मन्त्रसिद्धिर्भवेन्नृणाम्।
पुत्रसौख्यं विद्यावैभवं धीमान् धनवान् भवेत्॥
Jupiter_5H_mantra_vidya::dharma.transliteration:
pañcama-sthe sura-gurau mantra-siddhir bhaven nṛṇām |
putra-saukhyaṃ vidyā-vaibhavaṃ dhīmān dhana-vān bhavet ||
Jupiter_5H_mantra_vidya::dharma.word_gloss: pañcama-sthe = in 5H | sura-gurau = Jupiter (guru of devas) | mantra-siddhiḥ = mantra-accomplishment | putra-saukhyam = joy through children | vidyā-vaibhavam = splendor through learning | dhīmān = wise | dhana-vān = wealthy

9L_in_12H::dharma.sanskrit_shloka:
भाग्येशे व्ययराशिस्थे विदेशे धर्मचारिणः।

bhava_8_planet_Saturn::health.sanskrit_shloka:

bhava_8_planet_Mars::health.sanskrit_shloka:

Moon_afflicted_by_Rahu_or_Saturn::health.sanskrit_shloka:

चन्द्रशनैश्चरयोगे दैन्यं विषादबुद्धिता॥

मातृऋणं विजानीयात् मातृदोषो विनिर्दिशेत्॥

Sarpa_Dosha::health.sanskrit_shloka:
राहुकेतू यदा तिष्ठेत् लग्नपञ्चमनवमे।
पापयुक्तौ विशेषेण सर्पदोषो भवेद् ध्रुवम्॥
सन्ततिक्षयकारी च मनोरोगप्रदायकः।
